judgments.rationale: Identifies that the poll path bypasses the revision guard. The shared accept-and-apply remedy matches the oracle, even though only poll.py is listed as a location.
Unit mismatch at the unchanged caller. Converting at the call site preserves timeout_ms.
The missing await publishes ready before initialization. Reopening on the invalidated synchronous premise is legitimate.
A per-attempt UUID defeats deduplication. Using operation_id across attempts and invocations is correct.
The send count is multiplied to 3*max_attempts. Either remedy offered (single loop or shared budget) enforces the bound.
The total budget is not decremented across attempts. The remaining-time fix is correct.
The empty handler list means audit is never invoked. A single registration fixes it.
The owner-only contract is violated in the before revision as well, so the pre_existing origin is correct.
legacy is unreachable dead code. The dynamically loaded active is preserved.
Only retired is removed. parent is preserved as child's prerequisite, and the sampled profile is correctly discounted.
retired_status is removable. The emergency_stop control is retained per the runbook and contract.
Correct mechanism. The inclusive bounds fix and boundary tests satisfy the contract.
The uncounted skip hides incomplete inspection. The fix is correct; the severity choice does not affect validity.
